texts.zh: 这颗行星发射出怪异的磁力波，与我们目前为止所知的一切均大不相同，几乎可以说它就像想要与我们沟通一般。唯有对这一不同寻常的现象进行调查方才符合逻辑——我们可能遇上了一个行星大小生物形态的绝佳个例。
texts.en: This planet emits strange magnetic waves, quite unlike anything we have seen so far, almost as if it is trying to communicate with us. It is only logical to investigate this unusual phenomenon - we may have just encountered an extraordinary example of life on a planetary scale.

sections.zh: 这颗行星发射出怪异的磁力波，与我们目前为止所知的一切均大不相同，几乎可以说它就像想要与我们沟通一般。唯有对这一不同寻常的现象进行调查方才符合逻辑——我们可能遇上了一个行星大小生物形态的绝佳个例。
sections.en: This planet emits strange magnetic waves, quite unlike anything we have seen so far, almost as if it is trying to communicate with us. It is only logical to investigate this unusual phenomenon - we may have just encountered an extraordinary example of life on a planetary scale.

texts.zh:
我们起先认为这是一种刻意的交流尝试，结果发现它不过是一种不常见的自然现象。这颗行星产生的磁力波只要进行合适的调整和编辑，就可以听起来像歌唱一般，但这肯定不是由任何有意识的个体产生的。然而我们的一些科学家也发现，这“歌声”相当地吸引人。

也许我们可以利用这一现象，比如招待艺术家或VIP到空间站中，然后捕获这些信号，把它们作为一种放松的音乐播放给他们听。
texts.en:
What we first assumed to be a deliberate attempt at communication has turned out to be an unusual but naturally occurring phenomenon. The magnetic waves produced by the planet, given proper handling and editing, may sound a bit like talking or even singing, but they are in no way created by a thinking being. Some of our scientists, however, find it quite catchy.

It might be possible to make use of this phenomenon, possibly by hosting artists or VIPs at a station created solely to catch these signals and play them as relaxing music.

texts.zh: 这颗行星发射出了一系列信号，我们的探索无人机认为它们应该是人造的。但在进一步的检测后，我们发现这些信号不过是一些自然发生的不寻常但无害的磁力波。这一发现并没有产生即时有效的收益，但由于实在是太特别，在长期的研究中它可以提供一些研究数据。
texts.en: The planet is emitting a series of signals that our exploratory drones speculated might be of artificial origin. Upon closer examination, the signals were revealed to be merely a natural phenomenon caused by unusual but harmless magnetic waves. This discovery does not provide any immediate benefit to the collective, but given their uniqueness, studying them may provide us with some research data in the long run.

texts.zh: 这颗行星发射出了一系列信号，我们的探索工蜂认为它们应该是人造的。但在进一步的检测后，我们发现这些信号不过是一些自然现象，它的独特性质可以用于增强我们的工蜂与主脑的连接。用这颗行星产生的磁力波照射工蜂后它们可以更好地响应主脑的意志。
texts.en: The planet is emitting a series of signals that our exploratory drones speculated might be of artificial origin. Upon closer examination, they turned out to be nothing more than a natural phenomenon, one with the unusual property of strengthening the connection of our drones to the collective mind. It seems that drones exposed to the planet's magnetic waves respond better to the will of the hive.

tooltips.zh: 蜂巢可以复制这些磁力波，用于增强自己的意志。
tooltips.en: The hive can replicate these magnetic waves and use them to strengthen its will.

# 怪异读数 / Strange Readings

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 7级异常，每个帝国最多一次；在冰冻、贫瘠、寒冷贫瘠、有毒、破碎、气态巨行星或熔岩行星上权重2；荒野帝国为0；生成时清除资源点。  
  Level-7 anomaly, once per empire; weight 2 on frozen, barren, cold barren, toxic, broken, gas giant or molten planets; 0 for wilderness empires; spawning clears deposits.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 7101“咏唱的行星”：看似通讯的磁波其实是自然现象。普通帝国：建站播放“音乐”（凝聚力资源点）；机械智能：编目（6物理）；蜂巢：强化蜂群意志（凝聚力资源点与修正）。  
  7101 "Singing Planet": the magnetic "songs" are natural. Regular empires: a listening station (unity deposit); machine intelligences: catalogue it (+6 physics); hive minds: strengthen the hive (unity deposit and modifier).
